name: vc-roe
description: VC-RoE - Vibe Coding · Rules of Engagement. A Claude Code plugin that auto-detects project complexity (Scope x Criticality) and injects the matching methodology slice as additionalContext at SessionStart. Five tiers: T0 ad-hoc through T4 mission-critical regulated. Hook-driven heartbeat (UserPromptSubmit + Stop sentinel + PostToolUse fallback) keeps long sessions on cadence.
